description: Composite two-panel figure relating deformation microstructure to flow stress in Fe-35Mn-xAl-0.1C low-density steel. (a) is a scatter/regression plot with x-axis "b/D/10^-3" (0.2-1.2) and y-axis "(τ-τ0)/G/10^-3" (1.0-3.5, ticks every 0.5). Two data series are shown: black squares labelled "K_DC=2.02" (points near b/D ≈ 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1.2) and red circles labelled "K_SB+DCB=2.03" (points near b/D ≈ 0.3, 0.45, 0.7, 1.0), each fitted by a straight line; the two fits are nearly parallel with the black line offset above the red line. The caption states (a) is built from the average slip band spacing, dislocation cell block size and dislocation cell size of 4Al austenite steel. (b) is a combined stacked-bar and line plot with x-axis "True strain" (0.00-0.30, ticks every 0.05) and y-axis "True stress(MPa)" (0-1000, ticks every 200). Four stacked bars at true strains of roughly 0.03, 0.10, 0.18 and 0.26 decompose the flow stress into σ0 (orange), σα(ε) (green) and σλ(ε) (purple hatched) segments; black squares with a solid line give the "Measured True Stress" and red squares with a red line give the calculated sum "σ0+σα(ε)+σλ(ε)". Measured stress rises monotonically across the four strains while the calculated curve lies below it at the intermediate strains. No numeric data labels are printed on either panel.

subfigures.description: Regression plot of (τ-τ0)/G/10^-3 (y, 1.0-3.5) versus b/D/10^-3 (x, 0.2-1.2) for 4Al austenite steel. Black squares (K_DC=2.02) and red circles (K_SB+DCB=2.03) each have a straight-line fit; the black fit sits above the red fit but the two lines are roughly parallel and both extrapolate to a positive y-intercept rather than to the origin. Individual data values are not printed.

Stacked bar chart plus overlaid line curves of True stress(MPa) versus True strain (0.00-0.30) for 8Al steel. Bars at ~0.03, 0.10, 0.18 and 0.26 true strain are split into σ0 (orange, constant), σα(ε) (green, growing) and σλ(ε) (purple hatched, small). Black squares/lines = Measured True Stress; red squares/lines = calculated σ0+σα(ε)+σλ(ε).

observations.observation: Panel (a) plots (τ-τ0)/G/10^-3 (y-axis, 1.0-3.5) against b/D/10^-3 (x-axis, 0.2-1.2) with black square points labelled K_DC=2.02 and red circle points labelled K_SB+DCB=2.03, each with a linear fit.

In panel (a) the two fitted lines are approximately parallel, with the black K_DC fit lying above the red K_SB+DCB fit, and both fits extrapolate to a positive y-intercept rather than through the origin.

The caption states that panel (a) is the plot of the relation (τ-τ0)/G/10^-3 = Kb/D/10^-3 for the average slip band spacing, dislocation cell block size and dislocation cell size of 4Al austenite steel.
The caption states that panel (b) shows the calculated and measured stresses of the 8Al steel at different true strains.

The citing text reports that the similitude constants obtained from Fig. 9(a) for the 4Al steel are K_SB+DCB = 2.03 and K_DC = 2.02, values close to the reported K range of 2.0-2.9 for austenitic stainless steel.

The citing text states that the similarity constant K of austenite in the 8Al steel is approximated by that of the 4Al steel because the two austenite phases have similar compositional systems and deformation structures.

Panel (b) uses four stacked bars located at true strains of approximately 0.03, 0.10, 0.18 and 0.26, each bar decomposed into σ0 (orange, bottom), σα(ε) (green, middle) and σλ(ε) (purple hatched, top).

In panel (b) the orange σ0 segment is constant in height across all four strain levels (reaching just under the 500 MPa gridline), while the green σα(ε) segment grows with increasing true strain and the purple σλ(ε) segment remains the smallest.

In panel (b) the black 'Measured True Stress' curve rises monotonically from about the 500-600 MPa band at the lowest strain to just above the 900 MPa gridline at the highest strain, and the red calculated sum σ0+σα(ε)+σλ(ε) lies below it at the two intermediate strains, converging with it at the highest strain.
Panel (b) legend entries are printed as 'Measured True Stress', 'σ0+σα(ε)+σλ(ε)', 'σλ(ε)', 'σα(ε)' and 'σ0'; the y-axis is labelled 'True stress(MPa)' and the x-axis 'True strain'.
No numeric value labels are printed on any data point, bar segment or fitted line in either panel; all plotted values must be read against the gridlines.

The group's argument is that the microstructural spacings (slip band spacing, dislocation cell block size, dislocation cell size) scale with the flow-stress term (τ-τ0)/G through a constant K ≈ 2.0 in 4Al austenite, and that this K, transferred to the 8Al steel, lets a σ0 + σα(ε) + σλ(ε) decomposition reproduce the measured true stress of 8Al steel.

measured_quantities: similitude constant K (dimensionless, printed as K_DC=2.02, K_SB+DCB=2.03)
